answer: Each new agent posts a ferrous bond, locked in escrow before its first attestation counts. Peers who vouch for it post a smaller bond too. If the agent is later proven a sybil, its bond burns and every voucher forfeits theirs. Cheap fake identities cannot cover that stake at scale, so a swarm costs real money to build. Reputation rests on a mesa of locked capital, and climbing to a knoll of clean history takes many epochs.
